permissions.claim_scope: Raw Phase1 F semi-supervised contribution only. No DURA substitution, Phase2 or true on-orbit claims. U TX hidden; V no state updates; new SSL authorized by current user request.

sources: No external training initialization; same-row EMA/prototype carry across own segments only
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Current corrected F0 source handles and complete own ancestry in segment complete.json. Existing fixed F21 checkpoint is used for no-query smoke only; F20/F21 are frozen comparisons.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No target or cross-contract inheritance. Existing baseline source provenance verified by frozen_inference.load_F; baseline target scores only used by independent final analysis.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final50 student/11100 updates; no best-target or best-V checkpoint selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0=seed2026092701, GPU1=seed2026092702, GPU2=seed2026092703; <=2 total compute apps/card and <=6 own GPU workers; free>=10000MiB before launch; one independent CPU scorer.
execution.stop_rule: One real-checkpoint source-only smoke + two actual L/U backward paths, PASS immediately proceeds. Two identical technical failures stop new submissions, preserve healthy processes/all outputs. Wrong roles/truth/output or unlaunchable prediction stops affected new work. No performance-based termination/reordering/reruns.

expected_artifacts: Per-row resolved_config.json, source_contract.json, three own segment checkpoints and ssl_state.pt, progress/step telemetry, final student
Frozen source V clean/physical mixture diagnostic (720 fixed records, no updates) plus matched F20/F21 diagnostics
Per-row raw predictions for ALL seven fixed views before separate CPU truth-last score
Per-seed/per-scene/RX/TX/day scores, paired baseline differences, mean/sample SD, U exposure/weight/class coverage, full actual training cost
Independent launch PID/CWD/argv/GPU/log-growth evidence; all partial and negative results retained
